instruction.text: Select the living thing in this image.

correct.text: Plants are living things too! They may not move around quite as quickly as animals, but they still have movement.

instruction.text: Select different parts of the plant to find out more.

feedback.correct: Plants do not eat like animals, but they use their leaves to get energy from the Sun. They also use their roots to suck up water and minerals from the soil. This helps them grow.

instruction.text: Order the photos of the oak tree from youngest to oldest to show it growing.

feedback.end: All living things grow. In this example, an acorn grows into a sapling and then an oak tree.

instruction.text: Select the closest sunflower to find out more.

feedback.correct: Living things use senses to interact with the world. A sunflower can sense the sunlight through its leaves and turn by itself to keep its flower in the sun.

instruction.text: Select the dandelion seeds to find out how plants reproduce.

feedback.correct: Many plants create seeds to reproduce. These dandelion seeds hang on the end of mini parachutes and can fly as far as 100 kilometres!
